datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Guatemala in 2011, classifying food insecurity phases by administrative unit. The geographic data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions at four time points (January, April, July, October), with classifications indicating the severity and geographic extent of food insecurity.
